(()=>{const cms=[...document.querySelectorAll('.CodeMirror')].filter(e=>e.getClientRects().length&&e.CodeMirror); const cm=cms.map(e=>e.CodeMirror).find(c=>/trend_filter/.test(c.getValue())); if(!cm) return 'no cm '+cms.length; const lines=cm.getValue().split(String.fromCharCode(10)); const i=lines.findIndex(l=>/trend_filter/.test(l)&&/if /.test(l)); const at=Math.max(0,i-5); cm.scrollTo(null, cm.heightAtLine(at,'local')); cm.setCursor({line:i,ch:0}); return [i, lines[i]]})()
